About

I’m a Computer Science and Engineering student at NMIT, Bengaluru (graduating 2028), building Android and web apps that solve practical problems. My app FindIt helps blind and low-vision users find everyday objects with the phone camera, and I presented it at the iQOO Hackathon Grand Finale. I’m open to opportunities where I can keep building and shipping.

Pravrutti 2.0

Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences

Took part in this national-level technical fest organized by Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences. Project idea: RoadRipple, a predictive road waterlogging warning system. Received a certificate of participation.

iQOO Hackathon Grand Finale

iQOO India and Reskilll, Bengaluru

Reached the Grand Finale of a 48-hour hackathon. Built FindIt, an on-device Android object finder for blind and low-vision users made with Flutter and TensorFlow Lite, presented it to a jury and received mentor feedback.

KogniVera Hackathon

Worked in a team (Team Gigabyte) over 24 hours to design, build, debug and present a working solution.

2026

AWS Innovation Challenge 2026

AWS Student Builder Group at Presidency University, Bengaluru

Took part in the first round. The problem: small clinics, shops and schools hold sensitive data but have no security staff, so they cannot tell what a security alert means, how urgent it is, what to do, or whether the risk is gone. Received a certificate recognizing creativity, technical skill and a passion for building innovative solutions on the cloud.
